title: Everplans
description:
Everplans is a Series A funded startup that created a secure vault for sharing important & sensitive information with loved ones when you die.

I worked full time here after graduating from General Assembly. I was hired as a full-stack software engineer for a Ruby on Rails API & a React frontend. I worked on a wide range of new features including payment & account integrations with Stripe, internal support & administrator tools, and helping transition to V2 of the API.

My favorite project was migrating our user-data encryption from AES-256 to RSA public/private key encryption and implementing the new encryption scheme. The goal was to increase security by encrypting each user's data with a unique & personalized key that could not be used by anyone except for the user - not even us.
techTags: Ruby on Rails, React, RSA encryption

title: ANHD
description: I was contracted to create DAP Portal, a housing-data analysis & reporting tool for NYC Council members & staff as well as NYC housing advocacy groups & organizations. **Context**: The City of New York's local law 11 of 2012 requires that the city releases public data on an Open Data web portal. This portal contains a wealth of data from NYC building departments like the DOB & HPD on everything from complaints, violations, sales, construction permits, etc, about every property in NYC. The problem though is that none of these datasets are associated with one another so it's very difficult and time consuming to analyze properties individually, on aggregate, or by geography. This information is extremely useful for policy makers and advocacy groups because it helps them determine where to focus their efforts. Generally, it can take days for city staff to fulfill analysis requests. ANHD secured funding from the city council to create something to help solve this problem and I was hired with a designer to research, design, and then develop the tool. **My Work**: I created a data warehouse & API on Digital Ocean using Django, Celery, and Postgres. The app automated the process of pulling data from NYC open data APIs on a daily basis and cleaned, standardized, and created relational table structures between the datasets. The reporting tool used the data warehouse to give users a map and interface for constructing advanced queries & analyzing data by geography, category, and numerous other dataset attributes and filters. The API made this processed data accessible to the public with documented endpoints for CSV & JSON downloads. Another popular NYC housing app called Who Owns What uses the evictions endpoint for its eviction data.
techTags: Python, Django, Celery, CeleryBeat, automation, asynchronous jobs, scheduled jobs, admin tools, REST API, Postgres, advanced queries, React.

title: Justworks
techTags: Ruby on Rails, React, content management systems, Contentful, Heroku, Postgres, design system, pattern library, view components, agile
description: I acted as tech lead on the marketing team for Justworks.com during a period of departmental scaling and team-wide expansion. Some notable achievements include: - performing targeted improvements and refactoring of a Rails monolith that handles 1/2 million requests per day - building & integrating an in-house page-builder into our CMS that is now used by the entire marketing department to create landing pages - planning, scoping, & leading the development of an educational platform app from start to finish - implementing an in-house design system and pattern library to support a site-wide rebranding - refactoring our frontend into a Ruby gem & CSS library which is used on a few different sites & projects I also initiated and led the adoption of Agile & Scrum team processes to improve the department's ability to scale up and manage the increased work.

title: Eqip, Inc
description:
I was contracted by a small founder/owner medical start-up to create a radiology case-logging & educational platform.

**Context:**

Radiology residents around the country commonly still use pen & paper to log their cases and miss the opportunity to analyze cases for trends & improvements over time in a way that a digitized system would allow them to do.

MyIRLog was created with the goal of providing them with a digital case-logger as well as a content library for educational tools.

**My Work:**

I created a Ruby on Rails app which integrated with a 3rd-party HIPAA compliant data service called Caspio to deliver the case-logging service & graphical analysis. The format for the case-logs was designed by the founder/owner who was also a radiologist & educator.

I also setup the payment & Stripe integrations to allow individual users to purchase subscriptions to the service and for institutions to purchase organization-wide plans & seats for their departments. A few other features including an internal messaging app & quiz creator were also worked on before the company was sold.
techTags: Ruby on Rails, payment integration, medical, HIPAA compliant

title: Friend Design
description:
Coming soon - contracted by Friend Design to implement a CMS system & modern website design for Doctors' Center Hospital in Puerto Rico. The site includes a complete directory of their locations, doctors & staff, careers page, and news blog.

I went with Headless Wordpress for the ease-of-implementation for the backend which suited their content needs & the scope of the project. It also allowed for easy handling of content language translation and a flexible content modeling system.

I used GatsbyJS to efficiently put together a frontend client and a React component library. Gatsby provides pre-rendered pages for SEO maximization. The site is hosted on Netlify.

title: FLM / The Intercept
description: I was contracted to implement The Intercept's donation pages using ActionKit, which is a popular CRM tool built on Django. The contract mostly involed working with a designer, project, and marketing team member to style & create modular variations of the page, as well as connect everything to their payment processor.
